firearm.notes: Includes handguns and long guns; high precision on rifles/shotguns, lower on compact holstered pistols

bladed_weapon.notes: Kitchen knives, machetes; vulnerable to confusion with metallic utensils or pens when small

blunt_object.notes: Baseball bats, clubs; distinct aspect ratio, lower false positives

<25px (long-range / sub-pixel).assessment: FAILED (<50% recall). Handguns <25px cannot be reliably detected.

25-50px (mid-range 8-15m).assessment: MARGINAL (58.0% recall). Requires high contrast and crop upscaling.

>50px (close-range <8m / long guns).assessment: EFFECTIVE (87.1% recall). Strong spatial feature representation.

limitations: Weapons smaller than 32x32 pixels have <50% recall and cannot be reliably detected in wide CCTV views.
Long-range handheld items (>15m in 1080p) are sub-Nyquist blurred.
Single-frame candidate crops can be confused with smartphones, power drills, or umbrellas without multi-frame temporal voting.
Friendly forces (security officers, guard posts) require spatial or temporal suppression zones to avoid routine false alarms.
Purely decision-support: high-severity alerts are marked 'Needs operator verification' with zero automatic escalation.
